mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2.5% does not correlate with tighter monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE decrease > 0.3pp does not correlate with improved corporate earnings.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the previous 2 months signals a strengthening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator for economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST increase > 5% does not correlate with economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decrease > 1% does not correlate with negative market sentiment.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 2% annualized over the previous 3 months, it signals a tightening monetary policy environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2% does not correlate with tightening monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous 3 months signals strong labor market conditions, which is a leading indicator for economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increase > 200,000 does not correlate with economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 5% over the previous 3 months and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points, it signals a strong consumer demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 5% in 3 months and UNRATE decrease > 0.3pp
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combination of RSAFS increase > 5% and UNRATE decrease > 0.3pp does not correlate with strong consumer demand.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous 3 months signals a contraction in supply, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially in a regime of economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decrease > 1% does not correlate with negative market sentiment in an economic slowdown regime.
